description: Flexibits | Android Software Engineer | Remote | Full-time https://flexibits.com/jobs We make Fantastical and Cardhop, award-winning calendar and contacts apps for macOS, iOS, visionOS, and Windows. We are a small, fully-remote company spread across the US and Europe, and welcome anyone from around the world. We prefer candidates that are in time zones between US Pacific Time and Central European Time. We're looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Android developer to help bring the joy of Flexibits apps to Android. This will include learning the ins and outs of Fantastical and bringing its magic to Android, all the way from the natural language parser to the beautiful user interface. Tech stack: Kotlin, C#, Objective-C, Swift, AppKit, UIKit, SwiftUI, C, C++.
